# PWGen

> Free browser-based password and Hungarian passphrase generator.

Official site: https://pwgen.herczeg.cc/
Source code: https://github.com/vherczeg/pwgen

Key facts:
- Passwords and passphrases are generated locally in the browser with window.crypto.getRandomValues().
- Generated passwords and passphrases are never transmitted to or stored by the site.
- Copying a generated value to the clipboard happens locally in the browser.
- The site uses no analytics, no cookies, no tracking and no third-party runtime resources.
- After its own static files have loaded, the application performs no network requests.
- The passphrase generator currently uses a Hungarian word list of 16,384 words.
- The user interface is available in Hungarian and English.
- The source code is public and inspectable: https://github.com/vherczeg/pwgen
- Limitation: no generator can guarantee absolute security; the protection of an account also depends on how the service stores and protects the password, and on factors such as using a unique password per service and enabling two-factor authentication.

Note: this file is an optional, experimental documentation aid. It is not a
documented requirement for Google, Bing or OpenAI search discovery, and it does
not replace robots.txt, sitemap.xml or normal crawlable HTML.
